tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Find passages in the public reference library: Pride and Prejudice, Frankenstein 1818/1831 and The Art of War (Giles). Includes the four available sources with stable IDs for follow-up even when no passage matches; no personal library or internet search.

tools.name: retrieve_evidence
tools.description: Return passages, edition, locator and provenance from the bounded public library. To request an exact indexed locator, provide one source ID and that full locator. Multiple IDs permit edition comparison; missing evidence is reported.

tools.name: inspect_source
tools.description: Inspect one public source ID returned by search: work, edition, translator, public catalog, transcription fingerprint and complete indexed locator inventory. Cannot inspect private or arbitrary sources.

tools.name: explain_evidence
tools.description: Recompute evidence selection for a question and explain Strong, Limited or Insufficient heuristic coverage. Edition duplicates cannot inflate independent support. This explains selection, not factual correctness.

tools.name: find_evidence_gaps
tools.description: Identify corpus limitations and kinds of evidence needed for an unsupported question. No web search, acquisition, factual answer generation or personalized advice; suggestions are gaps, never retrieved evidence.
